name: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor
description: Fraction of a table's current size (reltuples) used to compute the insert-count threshold that triggers autovacuum for tables with heavy INSERT-only activity.
symptoms: Increased disk usage due to dead tuples
Slower sequential scans from bloat-induced page inflation
Delayed cleanup causing transaction ID wraparound risk
tuning_tips: Lower this value (e.g., 0.05–0.1) for tables with high INSERT rates and no UPDATE/DELETE to trigger vacuum sooner; raise it (e.g., 0.3–0.5) for mostly static or read-heavy tables to reduce vacuum frequency.
